title: Environmental reading event v1
description: Published on txori/v1/{station_id}/environment with QoS 1 and retain false. One event groups the metrics read at the same instant. Core rule: a missing reading is declared null with quality unavailable or error, NEVER as an invented zero, because a zero is data and a gap is not.

observed_at.description: Instant of the reading, not of the publication.

readings.description: PROVISIONAL in its list of metrics: it is closed when Elena confirms the real sensor models (docs/interfaces.md). Send only the metrics the station tries to read; a metric that is not attempted is omitted, and one that is attempted and fails is sent with quality error.

unit.description: lux ONLY if the conversion of the specific model is validated; otherwise raw, with the sensor range documented in docs/hardware.md.

value.description: Measured value, or null if there is no measurement. See the consistency rule with quality.

unit.description: Unit fixed per metric in properties. Changing it per event is not allowed.

quality.description: ok: valid measurement. unavailable: the sensor is not present or does not respond. error: it answered with a value that does not pass validation.

then.description: An ok reading requires a number: declaring quality ok with a null value would lie about the availability of the data.
An invalid reading requires null: it prevents a zero or a last known value from slipping in as if it were a measurement.
